mapper.sql: e.id AS expense_id, e.expense_no, e.customer_id, e.customer_name_snapshot AS customer_name, e.expense_month, e.goods_cost_amount, e.tax_amount, e.service_amount, e.freight_amount, e.commission_amount, e.reason, e.created_at, e.created_by, c.seller_id, (v.id IS NOT NULL) AS voided, v.reason AS void_reason, v.created_at AS voided_at, v.created_by AS voided_by
FROM xsy_finance_customer_expense e JOIN xsy_customer c ON c.id = e.customer_id AND c.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_finance_customer_expense_void v ON v.expense_id = e.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_finance_customer_expense(expense_no, customer_id, customer_name_snapshot, expense_month, goods_cost_amount, tax_amount, service_amount, freight_amount, commission_amount, reason, created_at, created_by) VALUES (#{expenseNo}, #{customerId}, #{customerNameSnapshot}, #{expenseMonth}, #{goodsCostAmount}, #{taxAmount}, #{serviceAmount}, #{freightAmount}, #{commissionAmount}, #{reason}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE e.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE OF e
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_finance_customer_expense_void(expense_id, reason, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{reason}, #{operator}) ON CONFLICT (expense_id) DO NOTHING
